caption: The drawing consists of three vertically aligned rectangular panels, each filled with different linear and geometric embroidery patterns arranged in horizontal rows. The patterns utilize a variety of colored lines, including red, blue, green, yellow, orange, and brown, each executed in symmetrical, repetitive motifs. In the left panel, there are diagonal crisscrosses, vertical lines, fan-like designs, X-like structures, wave-shaped curves, and zigzag borders, all in various color combinations. The center panel contains zigzag lines, diamond and cross shapes, vertical bars, small circles, arching fan shapes, and Xs with surrounding short strokes, also with mixed colors. The right panel features crisscrossed diamonds, starburst forms, stylized floral and fan motifs, chevron and zigzag rows, as well as more linear and angular decorative patterns, predominantly in red, yellow, blue, and green tones. Each pattern is distinct in construction and color sequence, with the three panels separated by clear dividing lines, and the background is a plain, light cream color.
title: Crazy Quilt Stitches
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
